Name: Rilakkuma Plushies
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
Adds 12 Rilakkuma plushies as furniture (includes 7 color variations of Rilakkuma, 3 color variations of Korilakkuma, Chairoikoguma and Kiiroitori)

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/V93CvTp.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ how to use: purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on the large futan bear to change it to any rilakkuma plushie of your choosing. use it on the small futan bear to change it to kiiroitori
♡ sprites made by me
